items: Booking status is checked for 4 AWBs at once, so your bookings fill in faster
Notifications name the flight even when it leaves after midnight
A landed flight no longer reads "scheduled" again a day later
New bookings get their flight in the alert, however far down the list
Track Shipment no longer shows Departed for an offloaded shipment
Closed notifications show the cities too - AI-2487 · Delhi 8:40 AM → Port Blair 12:05 PM
Notifications show the flight with the cities in full - AI-2487 · Delhi → Port Blair - then its departure and arrival
New booking alerts show the flight number with its departure and arrival times, even before the cargo is handed over
Notifications show the cities in full - Delhi → Port Blair
Booking cards show the right status - a shipment already departed no longer shows Not Accepted · Booked
What Track Shipment shows for a booking now shows on its card too
Notifications show the flight number with its departure and arrival times - status, offload, arrival, new booking, booking changes, Milestone Reminder and Live Track
A new booking, or a booking moved to another day, fills its flight in quietly once the app has read it
Capture AWB: the pencil beside Remarks and Handling Instructions shows again (it was an empty box), with no red ring left around it after its panel closes
Capture AWB: the portal's own Done / Cancel (Remarks, Handling Information and other panels) show again - the bottom bar steps aside while they're open
Capture AWB: after saving, a simple Saved message with OK
Capture AWB: Print AWB makes the PDF straight from the open page - no long preparing step
After saving, a clear Saved sheet with Print AWB and Go Back
The portal's own Save and Print at the top are hidden - the bottom bar has them
Capture AWB: Go Back, More, Print AWB and Save AWB together in one bar at the bottom
Unsaved changes are marked, and Go Back / Print ask before you lose or skip them
The bar no longer covers the form or the box you are typing in
Booking Summary: queued bookings with no flight yet show their shipment status again
Their route and date show at the top, and the empty 0h 0m is gone
Capture AWB: the Booking Summary / Print AWB bar shows again
Label printer: Scan finds nearby printers (it never found any, and kept spinning)
Adding a photo from a high-resolution camera to a note no longer closes the app
Restoring a settings backup on a new phone could stop App Lock from opening - fixed
Split screen, pop-up windows and foldables no longer reload the portal
Update Access (GitHub token) removed from Developer Options - updates need no sign-in
Home's My Bookings back to the portal's own list, as in the build with the bug fixes
Home: My Bookings redrawn - tap a count (To hand over, Accepted, Arrived...) to see just those bookings
Each booking shows how far along it is on one line, with the goods in full, pieces and weight
⋮ opens a sheet: Booking Summary, Track, Share, Milestone Reminder, Copy, Notes, Add to Home screen
No empty band above My Bookings. Settings > Appearance > New Home Bookings Layout turns it off
Edit AWB back to the portal's own page, as in the build before
Edit AWB: one box per row where they were cut off, bigger boxes to tap
Edit AWB: Other Charges as a list - the charge, its amount, who it's due to - nothing off the edge
Edit AWB: Notify and Additional Info folded; Phone layout on the At a glance card switches it all off
Edit AWB: at a glance at the top, tabs at the bottom to jump to Pieces, Charges and the rest
Edit AWB: boxes you change are marked, and Save shows what changes before saving
Edit AWB: warns when the chargeable weight is below the weight
Capture AWB: the Booking Summary / Print AWB bar shows again
Create invoice: CGST and SGST stay two lines when you type the tax amount yourself
App lock: the lock timeout you pick now works, and coming back from a share or PDF locks after 10 minutes
Saved documents stay if downloading them again fails
Web Mode: only answers to the phone's own address
Flights just after midnight that leave early show as early, not a day late
Measure a box: no crash when the camera can't start, and the box lands on the calculator
Flight Lookup: Express flights in All by the IX number they fly under
Booking Summary: find the route card when the portal draws it in pieces
Booking Summary: the app's summary on bookings without a LAT too
Flight Lookup: no empty band above the flights
Create invoice: rate a piece filled in from your own invoices, per customer
Create invoice: HSN of the goods filled in for far more goods
Create invoice: remove the Stamp
Create invoice: the seller's stamp beside Authorised Signatory
Track Shipment: Shipment waits for the timeline
Measure a box: aim on a box's side marks the floor below it, steadier aim
